verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents a public API with a callable Sandbox, an OpenAPI spec confirmed live by probe (HTTP 200 at openapi.json), official SDKs in Node.js, PHP, Python, .NET, Java and Ruby, and agent-friendly llms.txt and Markdown docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
